hotels.title: Benoa Beachfront Bliss near Nusa Dua with Three Restaurants, Three Pools & Onsite Spa
hotels.description: Discover your own slice of paradise along a stretch of Tanjung Benoa Beach at this family-friendly resort. Lose track of time by one of the resort’s three shimmering pools, get adventurous with an abundance of watersport activities or seek inner serenity at the onsite spa. With five diverse restaurants, cafes and bars onsite, curate your culinary journey as you please. Return to Cocos Beach Restaurant and Bar for laidback pizza on the shore, Crocokiss Restaurant & Bar for light bites or Nanas Bar for a late-night tipple. Just a 15-minute drive from the heart of Nusa Dua, Novotel Bali Benoa provides easy access to Bali Collection for some shopping and Museum Pasifika for a glimpse of the region’s artistic heritage.

hotels.title: Nusa Dua Beachfront Luxury with Daily Breakfast, Nightly Dinner, Massages & Free-Flow Cocktail Hour
hotels.description: Slip into this expansive tropical haven on a private golden stretch of Tanjung Benoa Beach in Nusa Dua, with a cocktail in hand and dinner on the way. Novotel Bali Benoa is your own slice of paradise, surrounded by lush resort gardens and direct access to the sea for easy relaxation. Backed by Novotel’s signature five-star service, every element of the resort delivers countless good times with family and friends. Visit Cocos Restaurant & Bar for laidback pizza on the shore, Crocokiss Restaurant & Bar for light bites or Nanas Bar for cocktails. Ready to explore? Nusa Dua has more than extraordinary beaches - though Novotel Bali Benoa offers an abundance of equipment for waterskiing, diving and more. Head to Bali Collection for the island’s best shopping, Museum Pasifika to glimpse the region’s spectacular artistic heritage and laze your days away by any of the resort’s three shimmering pools.
